label: D2 after choosing a1 following a rewarded trial; strongest on a1 -> S2 rare transitions
explanation: Fires only at D2 and almost only when this trial chose a1 (99% of mass) and the previous trial was rewarded (99% of mass); it never fires at D1 or GO, and almost never after a2 or after an unrewarded trial. Magnitude is set by the transition. The largest activations (near max) are a1 -> S2 rare transitions after a reward. a1 -> S1 common transitions give weak activations (about 0.1 to 0.4 of max) that build up over a streak of rewarded a1 trials and grow with trial index in the episode (rate goes from 1% in trials 0-9 to 7% in trials 90-99). The simple predicate D2 & a1 & prev_reward==1 gets recall 0.97 and mass 0.99 but precision 0.36, because many common a1 trials stay silent. Requiring a rare S2 transition or a late episode (ep_trial>=50) raises dev F1 to 0.66 with mass recall 0.98. The rare-only clause gives precision 0.70 but only 0.74 of mass. Everything in the predicate is observable at D2, so no future variables are used.
